Fixed. `AxiosHeaders.get('set-cookie')` now returns an array of cookies, matching the pre-1.x behavior.

Changes (mirroring the upstream fix for this issue):
- `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:19` — `normalizeValue` now normalizes arrays element-wise (`value.map(normalizeValue)`) instead of stringifying the whole array, so array values survive `set`/`normalize`.
- `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:342` — `set` now assigns `normalizeValue(_value)` directly (the redundant array special-case was removed).
- `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:455` — `toJSON` accepts `asStrings`; arrays are joined into a string only when `asStrings` is truthy, otherwise preserved as arrays (so the http adapter's `headers.toJSON()` keeps `set-cookie` as an array).
- `index.d.ts:42` — `toJSON(asStrings?: boolean): RawAxiosHeaders`.

Verification: the issue #5028 regression test (`test/unit/regression/bugs.js`) passes, all AxiosHeaders/parseHeaders specs pass, and the full unit suite shows only the same 2 network-dependent failures that already exist on the unmodified baseline.
